title: Business and Planning Act 2020 (Pavement Licences) (Coronavirus) (Amendment) Regulations 2021
amendmentMotionNotes: Lord Faulkner of Worcester moved, as an amendment to the motion to approve the Regulations, at the end to insert “but that this House regrets that the Regulations were not revised to take account of the evidence of the benefits of 100 per cent smoke-free pavement licences, which have been implemented over the last year in a diverse range of local authorities and which have received strong public support”. The House divided:

contents.name: The Lord Bishop of St Albans
The Earl of Cork and Orrery
